This loop — Learn, Practice, Apply — is designed to close the gap between knowing a language and being able to speak it under pressure. It is the core structure behind every Speak lesson.

— Learn, Practice, Apply — is designed specifically to move language from passive knowledge to active spoken fluency. Instead of exercises you complete on a screen, Speak has you speaking from the first lesson, with real-time feedback on pronunciation and phrasing and back-and-forth AI conversation to practice what you've learned.

Speak is also expert-built. The curriculum is developed by language education professionals who understand what it actually takes to go from hesitant to fluent — then personalized by AI to your level, goals, and learning history.
Duolingo and Speak are both popular language learning apps, but they have different primary focuses.

Speak is built around speaking. Its curriculum centers on getting you to produce language out loud, practice real conversation patterns, and receive feedback on your pronunciation and phrasing — from the first lesson. Where Duolingo trains you to recognize and translate language, Speak trains you to use it in conversation.

The two apps can be complementary: Duolingo for vocabulary and written comprehension, Speak for spoken practice and building the confidence to actually talk. If your goal is to hold a real conversation in your target language, Speak is designed specifically for that.
Speak is not a chatbot. It is a structured AI language learning app built to improve your speaking ability in a specific language.
The difference in practice:
With a general AI chatbot, you decide what to practice and how. Speak gives you an expert-built curriculum, level-based lessons, and a clear progression.
Speak gives you real-time feedback on pronunciation and phrasing as you speak — not just a reply to what you said.
After each lesson, Speak uses your mistakes and learning history to generate personalized review and custom practice. The experience improves the more you use it.
Streaks, leagues, reminders, progress tracking, and Made for You lessons are all part of the Speak experience. None of that comes standard with a general chatbot.
If you want more than open-ended conversation practice — if you want a curriculum, spoken feedback, and an app that adapts to your weak spots — Speak is built for that.
Speak makes language learning apps that help you get real conversational practice without needing a live tutor on the other end.

We believe that learning a language is one of the most life-changing and life-improving skills a person can acquire. It enables you to connect with new cultures, improve your economic condition, and generally live a richer life. Application to Japanese language learning

The Pimsleur method adapts to Japanese by placing strong emphasis on accurate pronunciation of the language's limited set of sounds, including consistent vowel pronunciation and the critical role of pitch accent in distinguishing word meanings.
This approach addresses Japanese-specific challenges such as the lack of stress accent found in English and the importance of intonation and rhythm for natural-sounding speech.
Polite and formal speech patterns receive dedicated attention to align with Japanese cultural norms, incorporating honorific and humble expressions alongside neutral forms.
This spaced repetition integrates spoken and written forms to support long-term retention of Japanese script knowledge alongside oral skills.
